regions.today: Mostly dry today with a mix of cloud and sunny spells but with better spells of sunshine developing during the afternoon. There is a slight chance of a few sharp thundery showers developing. Highest temperatures of 22 to 25 degrees, a little cooler near coasts with light easterly or variable breezes, occasionally moderate near coasts.
regions.tonight: Mild, dry and largely clear tonight in light variable breezes. Temperatures will not fall below 13 to 17 degrees.
regions.tomorrow: Dry tomorrow with long spells of sunshine. Highest temperatures of 24 to 29 degrees in light westerly or variable breezes.
regions.solar_uv: High Monday and very high Tuesday.
